stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 hash-object [-t <type>] [-w] [--literally] (--stdin|<file>...)

Compute the object ID for a given file and optionally write that file
to the object database.

Options:
    --stdin
        read content from stdin
    <file>...
        the file (or files) to read and hash
    -t <type>
        the type of object to hash (default: "blob")
    -w
        write the object to the object database
    --literally
        do not validate the object contents
